root_cause: Two different existing overrides commit a unit's OC where it does not change control. (1) s7475 r3 P1: pass 1 of _assign_units_to_objectives has 'elif obj_state == "held_threatened": should_hold = true', which pins EVERY movable unit on a held_threatened objective even when its need is 0. obj_center read friendly 20 vs enemy 9 (projected 7); the units that cannot move this phase (Guard Gamma engaged, Blade Champion) held it with OC 11 alone, so the existing KEEP-OC release (locked_oc_holds) would have freed Guard Beta, but that branch comes AFTER the held_threatened clause and never ran. Guard Beta held at score 47.6 vs 33.0 for the enemy-held obj_nml_1 (enemy_weak, OC 8, contest capacity 20). B branch (2 seeds): +23.0 value. (2) s7478 r3 P2: OBJ-ASSIGN-1 (quicker-arrival swap in pass 2) swapped Guard Beta (OC 9) in for the Prosecutors (OC 8, score 27.8 vs 26.0) on the empty, uncontested obj_home_2 (enemy_oc 0, no projected OC, vp 0.0) because both arrive in 2 phases and Beta has 6.4" vs 2.3" spare; the Prosecutors were pushed onto the contested centre. Arriving the same phase on an objective nobody can contest gains nothing, while the swap moves the bigger OC off the fight. (3) s7463 r1 P2 (not addressed): every objective candidate of the Kommandos was skipped (centre covered by two Battlewagons, RACE-SKIP/LONE-TRIP elsewhere) and the fallback 'support/screen' pass sent it to the held_safe obj_nml_2; a different mechanism (fallback pass), no narrow gate found.
fix_summary: FIX_MARGINAL_OC (default 1.0, 0 = base exactly). Two one-condition gates on existing overrides, one log tag [MARGINAL_OC]. (a) Pass 1 hold: a held_threatened objective with remaining need 0 no longer forces a hold when locked_oc_holds(oid) (OC of units that cannot move this phase > max(enemy_oc, projected_enemy_oc)); the unit falls through as if released by KEEP-OC (still held if it is the keeper and PLAN_KEEP_OC_ENABLED is 0). (b) OBJ-ASSIGN-1: skip a swap candidate when it arrives in the SAME number of phases (spare-inches-only quicker), has strictly more OC than the unit it displaces, the objective has enemy_oc 0 and projected_enemy_oc 0, and the swapped-in unit has a candidate at another objective still needing OC in state contested/enemy_weak/held_threatened. Whole-turn-quicker swaps are untouched (guardrail s7457).

risks: Bench reach is 0 in 8 games, so a full-game bench cannot measure it as built; the effect is unproven over 5 rounds. Gate (a): a freed unit leaves a held_threatened objective with only the locked OC beating the CURRENT/projected threat by a small margin (e.g. 11 vs 9); if the locked units are engaged they may die or be pulled away in the fight phase, or the enemy brings more than COORD-5 projects (reserves, Advance+charge), and the objective flips the next turn (rounds 3-5 primary hold). Gate (a) can also free a unit from a HOME objective (seen once: obj_home_2, locked 5 vs 2), which some primary cards pay for. Gate (b): the lower-OC unit keeps an uncontested objective; if the enemy later contests it, less OC is there; and the swapped-out unit may pick a contested objective other than the one the critic named (s7478: obj_nml_1, not obj_center). F1 (s7463, Kommandos) is not fixed.
